notes: Two taḥwīl branches meet at «كلاهما عن الزهري», written once: the shared tail. Branch one ends at فليح; branch two runs through يعقوب and «أبي» (the father of Yaqub, relation) to صالح
«بمثل حديث يونس ومعمر بإسنادهما» and «وقال عبد الرزاق موغرين» name other transmitters or wordings: variant groups, not routes
needs_ruling: «وزاد في حديث صالح قال عروة كانت عائشة ...» adds a second saying with its own isnad (Urwa from Aisha) after the main saying; the reading covers the main saying only
«قلت لعبد الرزاق» is a scene where Abd b. Humayd asks about a word: not a link
